knowledge:
- key_parameters: type=Subset of values 0 to 7 to restrict search to specific triplex types ;; min_len/max_len=Specify the length range of triplex stems composed of individual triplets ;; min_loop/max_loop=Define the range of lengths for unpaired loops ;; iso_pen=Penalization for isomorphic group change (default is 5) ;; min_score=Filters results to show only triplexes with scores greater than or equal to this value ;; p_value=Filters results to show only triplexes with P-values less than or equal to this value
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation for triplex search within R.
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing DNA sequences (from FASTA, BSgenome, or custom DNAString objects) to identify, score, visualize, and export potential intramolecular triplex-forming regions (H-DNA).
- pitfalls: Searching for longer triplexes or larger loop sizes increases the search space and consumes more computation time. Penalization parameters (like iso_pen, mis_pen, ins_pen) and EVD parameters (lambda, mi) should not be changed without consulting the reference paper [1]. P-value calculations are highly dependent on the genomic background (prokaryotic vs. eukaryotic).

workflows.name: triplex_search_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Search for intramolecular triplexes in a DNA sequence, visualize the alignments in text, 2D, or 3D, and export the results to GFF3 and FASTA formats.
workflows.stages: 1. Load the triplex package and define the target DNA sequence ;; 2. Search for triplexes using triplex.search with optional filtering parameters (type, min_len, max_len, iso_pen, min_score) ;; 3. Sort or subset the resulting TriplexViews object ;; 4. Visualize the triplexes using triplex.alignment, triplex.diagram, or triplex.3D ;; 5. Convert the results to GRanges and export to GFF3 format ;; 6. Convert the results to DNAStringSet and export to FASTA format ;; 7. Plot statistics such as score distribution histograms and coverage plots
workflows.code:
library(triplex)
seq <- DNAString("TTGGGGAAAGCAATGCCAGGCAGGGGGTTCCTTTCGTTACGGTCCGTCCC")
triplex.search(seq)
triplex.search(seq, type=1)
triplex.search(seq, min_len=10, max_len=20)
triplex.search(seq, iso_pen=2)
triplex.search(seq, min_score=14)
t <- triplex.search(seq)
t
triplex.alignment(t[1])
triplex.diagram(t[1])
triplex.3D(t[1])
gr <- as(t, "GRanges")
gr
library(rtracklayer)
export(gr,"test.gff", version="3")
dss <- as(t, "DNAStringSet")
dss
writeXStringSet(dss, file="test.fa", format="fasta")
library(BSgenome.Celegans.UCSC.ce10) 
t <- triplex.search(Celegans[["chrX"]][1:100000],min_score=17,min_len=8)
t
ts <- t[order(score(t),decreasing=TRUE)]
ts
triplex.diagram(ts[1])
triplex.3D(ts[1])
triplex.alignment(ts[1])
export(as(t, "GRanges"),"test.gff", version="3")
writeXStringSet(as(t, "DNAStringSet"), file="test.fa", format="fasta")
hist(score(t), breaks=20)
plot(coverage(ts[0:length(t)]), type="s", col="grey75")
